_meta.title: Functional-ontology word lists — single source of truth
_meta.purpose: The ONE place every verb / forbidden-word / persona / pattern list lives. The shared validate.py imports this; generator validators and validate-graph.py must import it too rather than re-listing words inline (ADR 0001, Phase 1).
_meta.provenance: Unioned from the three generator validators + validate-graph.py. Where the same list diverged, the SUPERSET was taken and the divergence is noted in _notes so nothing is silently dropped.

_notes.forbidden_ui_words: 23 canonical members (click..icon) + 2 ASP.NET-specific (postback, gridview) folded in from the aspx agent = 25. Match with WORD-BOUNDARY regex (\bword\b), never plain substring — substring over-matches ('tab' inside 'table'). Applies to HUMAN-persona actions only; system-persona actions are skipped (see human-overlay.md).
_notes.side_effect_verbs: 29 distinct = union of backend's 26 + the metadata pass's {execute, write, generate}. Backend's validator was MISSING execute/write/generate; this superset closes that gap. Triggers rule-a on the SYSTEM half (apis[] OR identifier-in-description required).
_notes.network_verbs: 21 members, UI-only originally. Triggers rule-a on the HUMAN half (non-empty apis[] required — no identifier fallback). 'generate' appears in BOTH network_verbs and side_effect_verbs by design.
_notes.input_verbs: Used by the advisory atomicity check (human half) to find data-entry actions. 'filter' added so MFLT-style filter actions are recognised.
_notes.forbidden_persona_names: 15 from validate-graph.py + metadata-engine/tech names {devops, verticle, filter, webappengine, engine}. A human persona name must contain NONE of these as a standalone word.
_notes.identifier_patterns: Backend rule-a fallback: a side-effect action with empty apis[] is still OK if its description names a Repository/table/entity/index/bucket/collection or an s3://|sqs://|kafka://|rabbit:// URI or an -> / → transform arrow.
_notes.api_types: apis[].type is FREE TEXT server-side (no enum enforced — PersonaDto uses @IsString). REST/GraphQL/gRPC/WebSocket/Event are the schema-validated set; SOAP is the recommended extension for ASP.NET/WCF/ASMX. See core.md § apis[] join models for the per-stack mapping.
_notes.overlap_keywords: PROJECT-SPECIFIC (these are a finance project's domain terms). validate-graph.py's cross-persona-overlap check should read these from project config, not hard-code them. Kept here as the legacy default so behaviour does not change; tune per project.
